about: Is public Wi-Fi safe. Factory #42, backlog row 47, slug publicwifi. One hard idea: the FTC's consumer advice 'Are Public Wi-Fi Networks Safe? What You Need To Know' (February 2023) says 'Because of the widespread use of encryption, connecting through a public Wi-Fi network is usually safe', but also that scammers 'create fake websites and encrypt them' and 'your data may be encrypted on its way to the site, but it won't be safe from scammers operating the site'; Apple's Safari guide says 'Some fraudulent websites masquerade as trusted websites by changing one or two letters of the website address', so check the site's name letter by letter. Sources read 2026-11-25, see BRIEF.md.
